facts.fact: Kiran stayed at Garh Neshar with Ila to mend when Meera and Rohan crossed back; he was too weak for the road and is absent from the Shilak Cairn at the thaw.

In chapter 31, Meera was in the room when Kiran sat silent at the drafting table beside Dilan's rope end and answered Rohan's 'It is for the next one' with a nod; at the thaw she reads that silence as a sign Kiran means to pay the Old Bargain himself.
Roop and Chand's rope-bond was tied at the Shilak Cairn, so it ends at the same first meltwater as Meera and Rohan's.
